objective: Provision separately isolated private Vault recovery infrastructure with exact snapshot and KMS scope; no live workload changes
authorization: User explicitly approved temporary isolated resources and separate IAM role with narrowly scoped snapshot/KMS access
model_fallback: Available primary owns Sol security/integration role
boundaries: Separate Terraform root and state; no live EKS ownership/network/PVC changes
No snapshot payload, tokens or recovery shares in Git, CI, model context or workstation
No public IP, internet gateway, NAT, peering or transit route
Only specific snapshot version, KMS keys and approved ECR repositories
Recovery execution follows separate reviewed ceremony; infrastructure creation does not restore data

delegation.review: Terra independently reviews IaC and least-privilege contracts
